prompt: How does a Go module signal a major version of v2 or higher in its import path?
explanation: Semantic import versioning encodes major version >=2 directly in the import path, e.g. example.com/pkg/v2.

options.text: The import path never changes across major versions
By appending /v2 (or higher) to the module's import path
Only go.mod records it; imports are unaffected
